verdict.rationale: Qodo's pricing page lists "Strict data retention" as a plan feature and states it does not train models on customer code, which is a first-party retention posture. Nothing documents user-facing controls to set retention periods or delete data. Self-hosted deployment is a different capability (deployment model) and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable retention settings, data deletion or purge controls, detail on what "strict data retention" means, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Plans list "Strict data retention" as a feature.
